items.text: After years of hair loss, I decided to get a hair transplant at Dion Hair Clinic. The result exceeded my expectations. The team was professional and empathetic, and I feel confident again.
The consultation was thorough and honest. They explained exactly what was possible and what wasn't. After the treatment, I received excellent care. The result looks completely natural.

As a woman, it was particularly important for me to find a specialist with experience in female hair loss. At Dion Hair Clinic, I felt in good hands from the beginning. The treatment was painless and the results are fantastic.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to your most important questions about hair transplantation

items.question: How does a hair transplant without shaving work?
items.answer: In a hair transplant without shaving, only the hair follicles to be extracted in the donor area are minimally trimmed. The rest of your hair remains at full length, so the treated areas are completely covered. You are immediately presentable after treatment.

items.question: How much does a hair transplant cost?
items.answer: The cost depends on the number of grafts needed. With us, you pay from €1.50 per graft. A typical procedure with 3,000 grafts costs about €4,500. In the free consultation, we will create an individual offer for you.

items.question: Is the treatment painful?
items.answer: The treatment is performed under local anesthesia and is largely pain-free. With our optional DPI technology, even the anesthesia phase is almost pain-free. After the procedure, mild discomfort may occur, which can be well controlled with pain medication.

items.question: How long does healing take?
items.answer: Most patients can return to their normal activities after 1-2 days. Redness and swelling usually subside within 5-10 days. Complete healing takes about 10-14 days.

items.question: When will I see the first results?
items.answer: The first new hairs begin to grow after about 3-4 months. The final result is visible after 12-18 months. We accompany you throughout the entire process and document your progress.

items.question: Is the result permanent?
items.answer: Yes, the transplanted hair is permanent. It comes from the donor area, which is genetically not affected by hair loss. The hair grows for a lifetime and can be cut, colored and styled normally.
